text:
Sam P: Heads-up — had a weird mid-rollout yesterday where we couldn't quickly abort and attach a short rollback note. took 8m to coordinate.
Dina M: ugh. what blocked the abort?
Sam P: deploy-bot supports /deploy abort but it doesn't create a release-note entry or pin the replacement version automatically. ops had to manually post notes and then pin. awkward during fire drills.
Dina M: ok makes sense. idea: add a new verb `abort-with-note` that does 3 things: 1) cancel rollout, 2) post a standardized rollback note in release channel, 3) pin the temporarily-stable image/tag.
Jorge L: also surface the abort reason as a structured field so the console can attach to the incident. maybe `--reason` and `--severity`.
Sam P: exactly. propose command syntax:```/deploy abort-with-note --env=staging --pin=redwood/service@sha256:abcd1234 --reason="bad-cache-behavior" --note="reverting 1.4.2-canary"```
Dina M: love it. minimal output should be: bot confirms abort, posts note template (who, why, timeframe), and creates a pin change PR or triggers pin workflow.
Anya O: won't this need a change-window check? if we're inside a locked window for prod, we should bypass gating for emergency aborts but log it as an exception.
Sam P: yes — add `--emergency` flag that requires a user acknowledgement and auto-tags the audit log.
Jorge L: rough implementation plan: (1) cli command -> backend RPC to orchestrator, (2) bot posts formatted message + reaction, (3) pin step calls manifest-service to create pin PR, (4) Console shows incident link.
Dina M: here's a tiny script snippet for the bot handler to format the note:```python
note = f"*Rollback performed by:* {user}\n*Reason:* {reason}\n*Rolled back to:* {pin}\n*Window:* {window}\n*Incident:* {incident_link or 'n/a'}\n"
```
Dina M: bot should use consistent emoji and header like :rotating_light: ROLLBACK to make it scannable.
release-bot: automated check — current prod change-window is CLOSED until 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. Emergency aborts require `--emergency` and at least two approvers.
Sam P: cool. next steps: I'll draft a tiny RFC and a PR in ops-tools for the bot command + handler. can someone volunteer to own the manifest-pin PR flow?
Jorge L: I can take the manifest PR flow (create branch, push pin, open draft PR).
Anya O: I'll write the small oncall-runbook note (how to use abort-with-note + required approvals).
Dina M: I'll prototype the bot message formatting and the template we post to #release-notes.
Sam P: thanks all. I'll open the RFC and tag @jira-release with the checklist. goal: have a working prototype gated behind a feature flag in two sprints. :thumbsup:
Jorge L: :thumbsup:
Dina M: :raised_hands:
Anya O: noted — will add to our runbook and slack shortcuts.
